id: title:dmarchuk:edit the subject in place and put the test email first on broadcast review

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Subject and Preheader editing and a test-email workflow to the Broadcast Review step, potentially improving email delivery verification and metadata review.
review.reason: The chunk contains complete, substantive hunks adding Subject and Preheader input fields, a test-email workflow, and state management for pending and last-sent tests. This represents a bounded, substantive improvement to the broadcast review and testing capability.
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the implementation of the new BroadcastReviewTestEmail component, updated LemonInput/LemonLabel usage, setEmail action, and complete broadcastWizardLogic changes, so the full connection between the review step and email editing behavior cannot be fully established. The benefit is inferred rather than demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new BroadcastReviewTestEmail component, the updated LemonInput and LemonLabel usage, or the setEmail action implementation. It also does not include the complete broadcastWizardLogic changes related to the review step autosave. Without these, the connection between the review step and the email editing behavior cannot be fully,

observations.behavior: Adds optional showTestButton prop and conditional rendering of the test email button.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new test email button to the broadcast preview, allowing users to send a test email before scheduling. This could help users verify email delivery and prevent sending errors.

observations.behavior: Adds cache.pendingTest to remember the recipient and email while the send is in progress.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores the recipient and email while the send is pending, allowing the UI to remember the recipient even if the recipient field is edited while the send is in progress.

observations.behavior: Adds lastTestSent and lastTestSentTo state and selectors.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds state and selectors to remember the last successful test email, allowing the UI to remember the recipient even if the recipient field is edited while the send is in progress.

observations.behavior: Replaces a single BroadcastEmailPreview component with a new layout containing Subject and Preheader input fields, while retaining the preview component below.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds Subject and Preheader editing capability to the Broadcast Review step, allowing users to review and edit email metadata before sending.

observations.behavior: Adds a new BroadcastReviewTestEmail component that checks if a test email was previously sent and provides a button to send another test, or prompts the user to send a test first.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a workflow step for sending a test email to the reviewer's own inbox before broadcasting, supporting the test-send-then-launch flow.
